headline: Monster Hunter Wilds comes to Switch 2 on December 4
title: Monster Hunter Wilds Switch 2 December 4 | Release Date | Gaming News
video_script: Monster Hunter Wilds is coming to Nintendo Switch 2. Capcom revealed during the September ninth Nintendo Direct that it launches on December fourth, twenty twenty six. The Switch 2 version includes wireless local play, cross play, and all the title update content, including the Grand Hub. The Ascendance expansion is planned for Switch 2 in twenty twenty seven. Will you hunt on Switch 2? Comment below!
description: Monster Hunter Wilds launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on December 4, 2026 with all title updates.
